title: Aoyagi Toya — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Today's library committee meeting should be taking place here.)

rows.Speaker: Third-Year A
rows.Line:
Oh, Aoyagi!
Are you gonna be on the library committee again this year?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, since I love books and enjoyed everything last year. I'm also glad to see you back again.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year A
rows.Line: Haha. Likewise.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year A
rows.Line:
I'll be counting on you, Aoyagi.
You're a veteran now, so I hope you'll be willing to help the first-years and newcomers however you can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I will.
Again, I'm glad to be back.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year A
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Let's do our best.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (In addition to us, I'm seeing a few other returning members here...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Many of them may've chosen this committee because they too have a love of books.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What do I do...?
I just took a peek inside, but I didn't see anyone I know...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought I'd get to learn about a lot of good books and stuff from this committee, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, stop...
You shouldn't be afraid of meeting new people!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?!
H-How long have you been standing there...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I heard something regarding learning about a lot of good books and such.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-So, you heard everything...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I wasn't sure when to interrupt to say hello.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: P-Please forget everything you just heard...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's not a problem.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But if it's the library committee you're looking for, you're in the right spot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, come to think of it, why is this committee meeting here instead of the library...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because it's against the rules to talk there. As such, it's common for us to meet in empty classrooms or preparation rooms.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone, may I have your attention?

rows.Speaker: Third-Year A
rows.Line: Ah, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line:
We were just talking about you.
Thank you for choosing to be on the library committee again. We'll be counting on you quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you for having me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A friend of mine decided to join this committee, so I'd like to take a minute to introduce her to all of you before the meeting, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line:
Of course.
Is that her behind you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
M-My name is Nene Kusanagi!
I'm in Class 2-A! It's nice to meet you all!

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line:
It's nice to meet you too...
Wait, huh? You seem really familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Third-Year A
rows.Line: Yeah, I've heard your name before somewhere too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Maybe from Tsukasa.
You're both in the same class, yes?

rows.Speaker: Third-Year A
rows.Line:
Oh, I remember now!
You and Tenma do shows together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we do.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line:
That's it!
You're the Cowardly Canary from “The Happy Phoenix”!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! You saw us perform?

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line: I did! I've been going around seeing a bunch of shows after getting hooked on musicals a little while ago!

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line: But “The Happy Phoenix” was the first one that made me cry like a baby. You guys did such an amazing job.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You made it through that meeting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Yeah... I was so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, Aoyagi...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Umm...
Thanks for introducing me to all the seniors...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, it was my pleasure. One of them had just asked me to help out the newcomers in any way I could.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Plus, they seem to already know who you are, so I'm sure you'll have plenty to talk about with them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... Again, thank you for everything you did. I promise to return the favor when I can.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was nothing, really...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But okay.
I'll be looking forward to that day.
